title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans
goal: Reproduce the source-defined integration, segregation and ISD state contrasts from real participant regional fMRI time series, preserving the initial labeled sedation/sleep scope in Datasets 3–5 and each named original panel's participant and condition eligibility, paired preprocessing and essential controls.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained initial static integration, segregation and ISD state-contrast family in labeled sedation/sleep Datasets 3–5. Preserve original panel-specific participant and condition eligibility; the exact complete contrast panel and aggregation remain unresolved. Do not expand this scope to Dataset-1/2 temporal findings, HCP or every paper figure, and do not treat every released condition column as an original scored condition.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 awake versus loss-of-responsiveness prediction across 19 participants under leave-one-subject-out evaluation, retaining source model and feature controls. This is a separate empirical prediction result; transition and cross-dataset panels remain separate original results. Improved classification cannot establish reproduction or improvement of the primary state-contrast finding.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

data_contract.neural: Participant-level regional BOLD time series, both with and without global-signal regression; publisher specifies dimensions and condition columns.
data_contract.labels: Dataset3 columns baseline/light/deep/recovery; Dataset4 baseline/light/surgical; Dataset5 N1/N2/N3/awake. These labels make state comparisons possible without figure values.
data_contract.split: Within-person state contrast; hold out complete participants/cohorts for predictive extensions. No random overlapping-window splits.
data_contract.controls: Matched GSR/noGSR inputs required by the original metric; compare motion/global-amplitude and simpler correlation strength, surrogate time series preserving autocorrelation.
data_contract.time_alignment: Static state metric initially avoids unknown transition-event timing. Sliding-window transition claims require exact TR and responsiveness annotation audit.
